meta_title: Pro Clean Newcastle | Professional Cleaning Services
meta_description: Pro Clean Newcastle delivers professional domestic and commercial cleaning across Tyne and Wear. Same-day quotes, fully insured, trusted local cleaners.
hero_eyebrow: Fully Insured & Local — Newcastle's Trusted Cleaners
hero_subhead: Tired of cleaning? We handle it all—homes and offices across Newcastle, so you get your time back.
services_subhead: From weekly domestic cleans to office deep cleans, we tailor every job to your needs and budget.

services.title: Weekly House Cleaning
services.desc: Regular domestic cleans that keep your home fresh and tidy without the weekly stress. We work around your schedule, every week or fortnightly.

services.title: Deep Cleaning
services.desc: Thorough top-to-bottom cleans including skirting boards, light fittings, and inside cupboards. Perfect before moving house or after renovation work.

services.title: Office & Commercial Cleaning
services.desc: Keep your workplace clean and professional. We handle end-of-day office cleaning, kitchen facilities, and washroom maintenance on a flexible schedule.

services.title: After-Build Cleaning
services.desc: New build or renovation? We remove all dust, debris, and mess left behind so your home is ready to move into immediately.

services.title: Carpet & Upholstery Cleaning
services.desc: Professional steam cleaning restores carpets, sofas, and armchairs to like-new condition. We use safe, eco-friendly products and methods.

services.title: Spring & End-of-Tenancy Cleans
services.desc: Full-house deep cleans tailored to landlord and letting agency standards. We ensure you pass inspection first time, every time.

about_pullquote: We clean homes the way we'd clean our own—thoroughly, fairly, and with real care.
about_para_1: Pro Clean Newcastle started over a decade ago when our founder realised how hard it was to find reliable, honest cleaners in the Tyne and Wear area. What began as a one-person operation has grown into a trusted local team, handling everything from weekly domestic cleans to large commercial contracts. We're fully insured, background-checked, and committed to turning up on time, every time.
about_para_2: Our customers choose us because we listen. We're not interested in cutting corners or inflating quotes—we charge fairly for solid work and we remember our clients. Half our business comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals, which tells you everything you need to know about the service we deliver.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Pro Clean

reviews.text: Been using Pro Clean for three years now and wouldn't dream of using anyone else. The team are reliable, polite, and my house has never looked better. Fair prices too—no hidden charges.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Had them in for a deep clean before we sold the house and they were brilliant. Got into every corner, made the place sparkle. The buyers commented on how immaculate everything was. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael P.

reviews.text: We use Pro Clean for our office twice a week. They're flexible, professional, and never miss a day. Our staff appreciate working in a clean, tidy space. Great value.
reviews.author: Nicola W.
